Compass is a new venture incubated within MISUMI Americas. We’re building it with the deep manufacturing expertise of Fictiv, MISUMI’s digital manufacturing platform.

Every physical product starts as a CAD model, and most of what it will cost is decided right there. An engineer uploads an assembly, and Compass reads every part the way an expert manufacturing engineer would.
